answer: That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. Receipts are issued in karst, burned on slash in willow, and listed in wander. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 50 epochs. Each duplicate costs another 184 dollars in locked collateral and another 9 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
